title: docs(qa): judge sign-out leftovers by who wrote them in console-sign-out-and-ended-session
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9QeWfiVREwaGv9ZFnZkZ1Qt)_

Fixes #33859

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：平台测试清单 `identity-auth.console-sign-out-and-ended-session` 升到 r3，只改 acceptance[0] 的判定口径（登出后看「被登出用户留下的键」），外加一行 history。
- 为什么改：QA 跑（#33853）登出后登录页多出 `flow-palette-recents = []`，这是从未登录的匿名登录页自己也会写的空列表，不属于被登出用户；旧口径把它判成红，产品本身没错。
- 风险与回滚：只改清单 JSON 文本，不动产品代码、不发布任何包；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/identity-auth.json` 中该条目的 acceptance[0].verify 与 history r3。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:platform-checklist`，预期输出 `OK — 16 areas, 429 items`，锚点全部解析。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Checklist text only; no product code, no pins, no changeset (`skip-changeset`: nothing under any package's `files[]` moves).

**`identity-auth.console-sign-out-and-ended-session` r2 → r3, acceptance[0].verify.** The old verify allowed only the kept keys after sign-out. On stock showcase the login page that follows sign-out also holds `flow-palette-recents` = `[]`, and so does a never-signed-in browser opening `/_console/login`. The new verify:

1. judges "no key the signed-out user's session wrote survives", the same test negative[1] already states;
2. names today's anonymous-shell state exactly, key **and** value: `flow-palette-recents` holding `[]`. Holding anything else is the signed-out user's and fails;
3. lists the kept set as `SIGNED_OUT_KEPT_KEYS` has it on `main`, which now includes `objectui:auth:signed-out-via-provider` (the identity-provider round-trip note);
4. tells the runner how to judge any other key outside both lists: compare it with a fresh never-signed-in context opening `/_console/login`. Same key with the same value there means anonymous-shell state, named in the run record so the verify can list it. Anything else is a FAIL.

`evidence` now also asks for the value of every key outside the kept set, since the judgment depends on it. The clause, negative[1] and the other two acceptance rows are unchanged. The `history` row carries `ref: #PENDING-33859`; a second commit replaces it with this PR's number.

**Why name the key and value first, with the diff only as a fallback.** The card offered either. A key-only diff against an anonymous visit would pass a leak that reuses the same key, for example user recents landing in the unscoped `flow-palette-recents`. Naming the value catches that. The diff fallback keeps a future anonymous-shell key from turning into a false red with no instruction.

## Verification

Read against `main` @ `895783a1`:

- **The sweep keeps only the kept set.** `ui/packages/auth/src/ActiveOrganizationStorage.ts` `purgeSignedOutUserClientState` sweeps both stores against `SIGNED_OUT_KEPT_KEYS`, which is `DEVICE_SCOPED_KEYS` (`auth-session-token`, the session-user key, `vite-ui-theme`) plus `objectui-locale`, `objectui-locale-seed` and `objectui:auth:signed-out-via-provider`.
- **The anonymous key comes back after the sweep.** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/context/FlowPaletteRecentsProvider.tsx` `FlowPaletteRecentsProvider` re-hydrates in an effect keyed on `userId` and always ends with `saveLocal(list, userId)`. With no user, `scopedKey(STORAGE_BASE_KEY, null)` (`UserStateAdapters.tsx`) is the bare `flow-palette-recents` (`PALETTE_RECENTS_KEY`), and `migrateLegacy` returns the list unchanged when there is no user, so the value is `[]`.
- **Live reading.** See Acceptance notes: the anonymous login page and the post-sign-out login page both hold `flow-palette-recents` = `[]`.

## Acceptance notes

- Live reading at `895783a1` (console built from this tree with `pnpm build && pnpm console:build`, stock showcase on a fresh port, Playwright, one context per leg):

  <details><summary>localStorage / sessionStorage per leg</summary>

  ```text
  never-signed-in context, /_console/login:
    local:   flow-palette-recents = []          session: (empty)
  admin signed in, after writing qa-probe-L to both stores:
    local:   auth-active-organization-id:u:ID, auth-session-token, auth-session-user-id,
             flow-palette-recents:u:ID = [], objectui-favorites:u:ID, objectui-locale-seed,
             objectui-offline-queue, objectui-recent-items:u:ID, os:recovery-pw-first-seen, qa-probe-L
    session: objectui:metadata:app:ORG:..., qa-probe-L
  after Account menu, Log out (URL /_console/login, no redirect param):
    local:   auth-session-user-id, flow-palette-recents = [], objectui-locale-seed
    session: (empty)
  ```

  </details>

  This matches the #33853 reading. Under r2 the sign-out leg is a FAIL on `flow-palette-recents`. Under r3 every key left is in the kept set or is the named anonymous-shell key with value `[]`, so the leg passes. Only the acceptance[0] leg was driven; the member landing and the revocation legs were not.
- Product-side alternative (not done here, per the dispatch): `FlowPaletteRecentsProvider` could skip `saveLocal` when `userId` is null, and the old verify would hold as written. The write carries nothing of any user, so it is not filed as a defect.
